Welcome to Silver Oak Pet Care, a trusted 24/7 veterinary hospital in Ludhiana, dedicated to keeping pets healthy, happy, and pain-free. With 40+ years of combined veterinary experience, our expert team provides advanced, compassionate care for dogs and cats.
On this channel, you’ll find easy-to-understand veterinary advice, pet health education, and real recovery stories straight from our hospital.
What we cover on this channel: ✔ Dog & Cat Diseases (Parvo, Distemper, Tick Fever, Ear Infections)
✔ Pet Surgery & Recovery Videos
✔ Puppy & Kitten Care Tips
✔ Vaccination & Deworming Guidance
✔ Grooming & Preventive Health Care
✔ Emergency & Critical Care Awareness
🏥 Our facilities include:
• 24/7 Emergency Services
• In-house X-ray & Ultrasound
• Advanced Surgery & Medicine
• Travel Certificates & Vaccinations
• Professional Pet Grooming
📍 Located in South City, Ludhiana, we proudly serve pet parents across Punjab.
👉 Subscribe for trusted vet advice, life-saving tips!
